subject: Marketplace credit recapture & territory alignment
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbuscloud.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Seller Support <aws-seller-support@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace credit recapture & territory alignment

Hi Sean,

We discovered a problem on our August invoice: credits that were supposed to stay in the US West territory were recaptured against our global credit pool and applied to APAC usage. That shifted billing and reduced our US West listing credit by ~24.6k USD (see attached invoice stub). We believe this is a marketplace-side metering/territory mapping issue.

Can Redwood help coordinate with AWS Marketplace to:
- Confirm whether the charges were misattributed by territory at meter ingestion.
- Request recapture and reallocation of the 24,600 USD to our US West bucket.
- Confirm any downstream impact on our committed listing credits for Q4.

I've cc'd AWS seller support but wanted to loop you as our Redwood listing contact. Attached: 2026-08-invoice-aws-marketplace.pdf (invoice extract).

Thanks,

Priya Shah
Head of Partnerships, NimbusCloud
priya.shah@nimbuscloud.io
+1 415-555-0198

---
Attachment: 2026-08-invoice-aws-marketplace.pdf (PDF invoice extract, 1 page)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbuscloud.io>, AWS Marketplace Seller Support <aws-seller-support@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace credit recapture & territory alignment

Priya — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice extract. We're looking into this. Quick plan:

1) Karthik / Finance will pull the July–August billing activity and confirm the ledger entries.
2) I'll open a formal case with AWS seller support and request a territory reallocation + recapture.
3) Vanessa (partnerships) will validate the listing configuration to rule out mapping misconfigurations on our side.

Can you confirm the preferred accounting treatment if AWS issues a credit (credit memo vs negative invoice)? That will determine how we post and whether it impacts your committed listing credits.

I'll attach our internal billing extract once Karthik has it.

Sean Gallagher
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbuscloud.io>, AWS Marketplace Seller Support <aws-seller-support@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace credit recapture & territory alignment

On Sep 8, 2026, Sean Gallagher wrote:
> Priya — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice extract. We're looking into this.

Priya / team — I pulled the billing activity for Aug and tied the rows to the Marketplace metering IDs. Preliminary notes:
- Amount in question: USD 24,600 (net of discounts).
- Metering IDs indicate the usage was labeled to apac-01 in ingestion (should have been us-west-2).
- Contract CLA (section 2.3) allows for post-factum adjustments by Marketplace ops when misattribution is confirmed.

Suggested next steps from Finance/Procurement:
- Sean, please open the official AWS case (include the metering IDs and our billing extract).
- I'll prepare a short memo for Accounting that details debit/credit postings and how we handle committed credit pools (credit memo vs negative invoice). For Nimbus, a credit memo is cleaner — preserves the original invoice series.
- If AWS requests an amendment to the listing terms to reflect territory granularity, Legal/Partnerships will need to sign.

Attaching billing-activity-log.csv (first pass) for your review.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
---
Attachment: billing-activity-log.csv (CSV, 12 rows)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbuscloud.io>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Seller Support <aws-seller-support@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace credit recapture & territory alignment

Priya — good news: AWS ops has reviewed our case and agreed to reallocate the USD 24,600 from the global credit pool back to NimbusCloud's US West listing bucket.

What's enclosed and next steps:
- Attachment: AMENDMENT_AWS_LISTING_202609.pdf — AWS prepared a short amendment that documents the territory mapping correction; we've signed on Redwood's side and asked Nimbus to sign the counterparty section.
- AWS will issue a credit memo that posts to your account by 2026-09-17; they confirmed it will not reduce your committed listing credits for Q4.
- Internal accounting action: Karthik, please post the credit memo as a contra-revenue item as discussed; I'll update the HubSpot deal and mark the billing exception resolved. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/56789

Priya, can you review and sign the amendment by EOD 2026-09-16 so AWS can close their ticket? If you prefer, I can route the DocuSign link (sent separately). After signature I'll share the AWS credit memo number and final posting details.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Phone: +1 650-555-0246
